spec.baseline: 10-asset equal-weight Buy-and-Hold benchmark and 3-asset trio baseline (Iteration 3: Sharpe 1.572).

costs.assumptions: Binance USD-M Futures VIP 0 maker fee of 1.8 bps with BNB discount and 0.0 bps slippage for passive limit fills (3.6 bps roundtrip). Signed 8-hour perpetual funding rate cash flows applied at settlement marks.

evaluation.plan: Evaluate 10-asset universe portfolio construction (Equal-weight, Volatility-Targeted, and Cross-Sectional Ranking) over 4-year development data. Holdout window (2025-01-01 to 2026-07-31) remains strictly untouched until Phase 7.

spec.falsifier: Reject the thesis if: 1. 10-asset portfolio annualized net Sharpe ratio fails to exceed 1.00 on development data. 2. Maximum portfolio drawdown exceeds 20.0%. 3. Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) fails to exceed 0.85 across cumulative evaluated trials. 4. Trading friction consumes more than 15.0% of gross trading profits under maker execution.
spec.mechanism:
1. Cross-Asset Diversification: Expanding breadth from 3 to 10 assets dampens idiosyncratic coin crashes
   (e.g., individual regulatory or network shocks) while capturing widespread crypto macro liquidity expansions.
2. Volatility Risk Parity: Equalizing marginal risk contribution ($w_i \propto 1/\sigma_i$) ensures high-beta
   meme/alt tokens (DOGE, AVAX) do not dominate portfolio variance relative to large caps (BTC, ETH).
3. Execution Spread Advantage: Passive maker post-only limit orders reduce portfolio churn friction to 3.6 bps roundtrip,
   enabling high-capacity multi-asset trend harvesting.
spec.thesis: Extending Time-Series Momentum across a 10-asset diversified panel of major Binance USD-M perpetual futures (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, NEAR, BAND, BAL) with passive maker execution (1.8 bps fee, 0.0 bps slippage) and volatility-targeted risk parity achieves enhanced risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe > 1.20, Max DD < 20%) and cross-sectional diversification resilience relative to a concentrated 3-asset trio.

trials.description: Equal-weight TSMOM across 10 assets: 10% maximum target weight per coin with positive ROC_168 under maker execution.
Volatility-targeted risk parity TSMOM across 10 assets: Inverse volatility scaling (1 / sigma_i) normalizing annualized risk budget across the 10-coin panel.
Cross-sectional relative momentum: Long only the top 3 coins (top 30%) with highest positive ROC_168, concentrating capital in the strongest market leaders.
Multi-factor regime-gated 10-asset TSMOM: Scaling risk continuously by ADX trend conviction and choppiness filters.
